infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vyaamikk Diary can attach optional location footprints to records you save while the app is open, so you can view them on Calendar & Maps. Location is not collected in the background.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vyaamikk Diary needs access to your photo library so you can attach an official letterhead image for letterhead PDFs.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Vyaamikk Diary can save exported PDFs to your photo library if you choose to.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vyaamikk Diary uses the camera only when you choose to attach a letterhead image, cash-paid receipt photo, or customer photo to your own business records.
